title: lessingia germanorum subsp. eutenuis
intro: Lessingia germanorum subsp. eutenuis, commonly known as Mountain Fetterbush, is a flowering plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues. The health benefits of Mountain Fetterbush are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe coughs, ease congestion, and combat infections. Bioactive constituents of Mountain Fetterbush include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
